tldr: Lilith in Scorpio: raw depth, taboo, and power
body: Lilith in Scorpio: raw depth, taboo, and power. A strong placement. Where you reclaim sexuality, intensity, and what others fear. Watch: control, obsession, and revenge. Raw power and depth: you refuse to be controlled, owned, or exposed. A strong placement for this point. A natural depth-reader and instinctive therapist, tuned into what others feel beneath the surface. Uncertain, it can push past boundaries or feed on intensity; matured, it respects others' edges and can hold grief and darkness with compassion. Depth work and honoring boundaries are the path.
business: Owned, this is unflinching honesty about power and the hidden.
shadow: Suppressed it becomes obsession and distrust; unchecked, control and vengeance.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
